title: Expiration warnings for postings
summary: Customers who publish postings are not told before a posting expires, so listings drop off without anyone noticing in time to act. They want a warning sent at least a week ahead so the poster can renew or extend before the listing disappears.

log.why: Postings coming down with no notice to their owner is a new area not covered by any existing theme.
The yard learning a listing dropped only when someone phones is the same gap as missing expiration warnings for postings.
The ask for a week of advance warning before a posting expires is the feature side of the existing expiration warnings for postings theme.
